papers.title_en: TopX: Text-to-Motion for Unseen Skeletons from the Skeleton File Alone
papers.authors: Tengjiao Sun, Pengcheng Fang, Xiaoyu Zhan, Dongjie Fu, Xiaohao Cai, Hansung Kim
papers.evidence: 流匹配Transformer实现未见骨架的文本到动作生成
papers.tldr: 文本驱动动作模型通常只适用于训练中见过的骨架，新角色仅有骨架文件时难以生成动作。TopX用73M参数流匹配Transformer，从关节树、静止姿态和关节名生成关节旋转与根轨迹，并以骨架图热核坐标和帧旋转编码实现任意拓扑的时空注意力。在SkelShift基准上，对无训练片段的测试骨架，TopX将描述子FID从5.73降至4.58，动力学FID从1.48降至0.55，并减少穿地帧，显示无需微调的跨骨架泛化能力。
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-motion models generate for the skeletons they were trained on, while a new character arrives as a skeleton file and nothing else. We study text-to-motion for skeletons that no training clip has used, with no clips of the character, no template, no retargeting and no fine-tuning. We present TopX, a 73M-parameter flow-matching transformer that generates joint rotations and a root trajectory for any kinematic tree from its tree, rest pose and joint names. Motion is normalised by the rest pose and the size of the skeleton, and the rest pose enters as a world-frame descriptor that does not depend on how the rig's author oriented each joint, with rest conventions randomised in training. Attention is factorised over the joints and the frames of a motion and carries a spatial--temporal encoding designed for skeleton graphs of any topology: queries and keys are rotated across joints by a heat-kernel coordinate of the skeleton graph, which is defined for every tree and does not change with the order of its joints or the eigenbasis of its Laplacian, and across frames by a rotary encoding of frame order. To measure what this buys, we build SkelShift: four motion corpora under one codec, 143,334 captioned clips on skeletons of 4 to 142 joints, from which 4,232 clips on 2,043 skeletons are held out by clip, rig, tree class or species and organised along topology, joint count, body plan, species and rig source, and scored by motion quality: Fréchet distances on public kinetic features and on kinematic descriptors, foot skating and ground contact. Against UniMate trained on the same clips, on test rigs without a training clip, TopX lowers the descriptor FID from 5.73 to 4.58 when UniMate's guidance is tuned for the kinetic FID, and the kinetic FID from 1.48 to 0.55 when it is tuned for the descriptor FID, also on motions no training skeleton performs; fewer of its frames sink below the ground.

papers.title_en: Cumulative Marginal Matching for One-Step Diffusion
papers.evidence: 通过累积边缘匹配加速流匹配与扩散采样
papers.tldr: 扩散与流匹配模型通常需数百步去噪，推理代价高。现有少步/一步方法多在单点对齐轨迹，仅实现局部匹配；Shortcut-CSL 虽累积约束，却未直接对齐全过程分布。为此提出累积边际匹配 CMM，以 Wasserstein-2 度量基础模型与少步模型在整条边际序列上的累积差异，并转化为可采样优化的替代目标。实验表明在相同训练预算下，CMM 的生成质量优于 Shortcut-CSL 及多种先进少步/一步基线。
papers.abstract_en: The sampling procedures of diffusion and flow-matching models involve hundreds of denoising steps incurring substantial inference time, which has motivated a growing body of work on training schemes for few-step and one-step generation. Existing approaches primarily seek to align the generation trajectory of few-step and base models, yet their training objectives only involve discrepancies at a single point in the trajectory, encouraging only local \emph{point-level} alignment. While recent methods such as \emph{Shortcut-CSL} introduce cumulative objective that enforce alignment over the entire trajectory, this is suboptimal as they do not directly enforce alignment between the distributions induced by the two models throughout the generation process. We propose \emph{Cumulative Marginal Matching} (CMM), a principled objective for few-step generation: by viewing flow-matching as a sequence of intermediate marginal distributions connecting the prior and data distributions, CMM directly optimizes the cumulative discrepancy between the base and few-step marginal distributions over the entire sequence. Specifically, we formulate this discrepancy using the Wasserstein-2 distance. By exploiting the pushforward representation of flow-matching, we transform an intractable cumulative Wasserstein objective into a tractable surrogate that can be optimized using samples from the intermediate marginal, which are readily generated through the conditional interpolation process of flow-matching. Furthermore, we show that the existing \emph{Shortcut-CSL} objective arises as a first-order approximation of that of the CMM, establishing a theoretical connection between the two objectives. Experiments on standard benchmarks demonstrate improvement in generation quality over \emph{Shortcut-CSL} and other state-of-the-art one- and few-step baselines under identical training budgets.

papers.title_en: CounterFlow: Target-Conditioned Flow Matching for Visual Counterfactuals
papers.authors: Paul Sevellec, Elisa Fromont, Romaric Gaudel, Laurence Roze, Paul Viallard, Laetitia Houeix
papers.evidence: 基于条件流匹配生成反事实解释
papers.tldr: 在可解释AI中，反事实解释能直观说明模型决策，但生成逼真视觉反事实仍受计算开销与真实感限制。CounterFlow基于条件流匹配，用目标类别条件向量场直接把源图像导向指定目标类，在原始像素空间完成语义修改。标准基准上，它在视觉真实感和目标类切换上达到SOTA，且计算开销低于GAN或扩散架构。该工作为实际部署提供了更高效的视觉反事实解释方案。
papers.abstract_en: In eXplainable AI, counterfactual explanations have gained significant traction by offering users direct, intuitive, and actionable insights into model decisions. We introduce CounterFlow, a novel framework based on Conditional Flow Matching that generates visual counterfactual explanations by directly steering a source image toward a user-specified target class. By leveraging target-conditioned vector fields, CounterFlow identifies highly realistic semantic modifications while requiring substantially lower computational overhead than traditional GAN- or diffusion-based architectures. Empirical evaluations on standard benchmarks demonstrate that CounterFlow achieves state-of-the-art performance in both visual realism and target class switching. By working directly in the raw pixel space, CounterFlow offers a more practical solution for real-world deployment.

papers.title_en: Compatible Likelihoods for Flow Matching on Manifolds
papers.authors: Lucas Ng, Georgios Batzolis, Mark Girolami
papers.evidence: 流形上的流匹配目标理论
papers.tldr: 流匹配扩展到黎曼流形时，可能出现目标函数全局最优却把样本推离数据的失效。作者将其归因于似然目标缺乏“相容性”，即总体最优应恢复数据与耦合诱导的边际速度场，并给出一般判定与误差界。针对已有相容目标在紧流形上给不可行速度分配密度的问题，他们用端点指数族构造仅支持可行速度且相容的新目标，等价于对损失重加权。实验在平坦环面、高维乘积环面、球面地理数据和人体姿态上验证了速度恢复、NLL与样本指标改进。
papers.abstract_en: On the simplest non-Euclidean manifold, the 1D flat torus, we exhibit a distribution where a recently proposed extension of Riemannian flow matching is globally optimized by a velocity field that pushes samples away from the data distribution. We trace this failure mode to a property we call compatibility; a likelihood-based flow matching objective is compatible if its population minimizer recovers the marginal velocity field induced by the data and coupling. We give a general condition for compatibility, apply it to existing methods, and bound the worst-case error in terms of a residual component vanishing under compatibility. Next, we note that existing compatible objectives put density on velocities that are infeasible on compact manifolds. We propose an objective built from an exponential family over endpoints, with the conditional velocity as sufficient statistic, which is both compatible and supported only on feasible velocities. This manifests as a reweighting of the flow matching loss which, on constant-curvature manifolds, treats errors in flow speed and direction differently. Empirically, our method recovers the correct velocity field on the test case, outperforms prior methods on high-dimensional product tori, and obtains substantial NLL improvements over prior work on two of four standard geospatial benchmarks on the sphere at moderate runtime overhead. On a large dataset of high-dimensional human poses, our method outperforms prior work according to sample-based metrics.

papers.title_en: Trajectory Matching: Discrete Flow Matching with Structured Actions
papers.authors: Niklas Kemper, Marten Lienen, David Lüdke, Stephan Günnemann
papers.evidence: 面向结构化动作序列的离散流匹配
papers.tldr: 结构化离散生成需要片段添加、节点连边、层级生长等整体动作，但现有离散流匹配受端点条件限制，只能做固定尺寸的独立分量编辑。本文提出轨迹匹配，以连接端点的完整动作序列为条件，为可改变尺寸、多分量协同及有前置依赖的自定义动作空间提供免模拟训练目标。理论证明其恢复边际流并严格包含因子化DFM；树与分子图生成达到或超过基线，MOSES有效率从92.8%升至99.2%，且无需重训可迁移到子结构扩展与连接，拓展了离散流匹配的设计空间。
papers.abstract_en: The natural units of structured discrete generation are often not independent single-component edits but richer actions: attaching a fragment to a molecule, inserting a node together with an incident edge, or growing a hierarchy by adding a child. Yet most existing discrete flow matching methods (DFM) are restricted to independent component-wise edits over fixed-size states. This restriction stems from endpoint conditioning: endpoints fix the source and target during training but not the action sequence between them, making tractable conditional rates hard to define for complex actions that cannot be factorized component-wise. We propose trajectory matching, which conditions the flow on a full sequence of actions connecting the endpoints. This yields principled, simulation-free training targets for user-defined action spaces, including actions that change state size, modify multiple components, or depend on earlier actions. We prove that the resulting objective recovers the marginal flow and that trajectory matching strictly subsumes factorized DFM, while additionally capturing actions with prerequisite structure such as hierarchy growth or fragment-based molecule generation. Empirically, on tree and molecular graph generation, trajectory matching with domain-aligned actions matches or surpasses factorized DFM baselines (lifting MOSES validity from 92.8% to 99.2%) and transfers without retraining to substructure extension and linking. Trajectory matching enlarges the design space of discrete flow matching by turning the action vocabulary into a modeling choice. An interactive explanation of trajectory matching is available at https://niklaskemper.com/blog/trajectory-matching/.

papers.authors: Baiyu Su, Runlong Liao, Lizhang Chen, Qiang Liu
papers.tldr: 连续流/扩散语言模型可并行快速生成，但质量仍难追上自回归模型。ReLF用整流流把噪声输运到词嵌入，并结合Hellinger-SVD固定嵌入、交叉熵训练的自条件引导与正则化重流，实现少步生成；还提出奇异logits，在噪声消退时推动有效词嵌入承诺，并用有界神经残差学习上下文偏好。在OpenWebText上，64次函数评估时，三种规模均以匹配多样性取得低于自回归基线的生成困惑度；两轮重流后仅16次评估仍优于基线，批量1下生成1024词序列快15-19倍。该工作提升了连续流语言生成的效率与质量竞争力。
papers.abstract_en: Continuous-state flow and diffusion models offer a promising approach to fast, parallel language generation, but matching the generation quality of autoregressive models remains challenging. We present Rectified Language Flow (ReLF), a language model that generates text by transporting noise to token embeddings using rectified flow. ReLF combines several complementary design choices: fixed token embeddings constructed with Hellinger-SVD, self-conditioning guidance trained with cross-entropy, and regularized reflow for few-step generation. We further introduce singular logits, which combine an analytically computed term that drives commitment to a valid token embedding as noise vanishes with a bounded neural residual that learns contextual token preferences. With 64 function evaluations on OpenWebText, ReLF achieves lower generative perplexity than autoregressive baselines at matched diversity across all three model sizes tested, while also outperforming prior continuous flow methods in this setting. After two reflow rounds, ReLF still outperforms autoregressive baselines with 16 function evaluations while generating 1,024-token sequences 15-19 times faster at batch size 1.
